library.name: Agent-Based Components
library.description: Agent-based modelling on the shared discrete-event kernel. Agents are stateful individuals whose statechart transitions schedule events on the kernel clock, so agent behaviour interleaves exactly with discrete-event and system-dynamics components.

components.name: population
components.label: Population
components.description: A collection of agents sharing one agent definition (attributes plus a statechart). Agents may message each other over the population's network topology. A `depart` action sends an agent out of the population as a discrete-event entity through an out port; when that entity later arrives at an in port, the agent re-enters and its `arrive`-triggered transitions fire. Per-state agent counts are observable as `<id>.inState.<stateId>` in outputs and expressions.

ports.description: Agents departing the population as entities, triggered by a `depart` action in the agent statechart.
Entities arriving here re-enter the population as their original agents, firing `arrive` triggers.

size.description: Number of agents created at simulation start.

init.description: Initial value, sampled per agent if stochastic.

attributes.description: Per-agent state variables, readable in agent-scope expressions and writable via `set` actions.

agent.description: The agent definition shared by every agent in this population.

network.description: Connectivity used by `send` actions addressed to `connected`.

state.description: Agents currently resident in the population (departed agents are excluded until they return).
Departed agents whose entities are still buffered at the population's out port, waiting for the downstream component to accept them.
Agents currently in a given statechart state, published per state as `inState.<stateId>`.

emits.description: Emitted whenever an agent changes statechart state.
Emitted whenever an agent sends a message.
Emitted whenever an agent writes to the log action.
Emitted when an agent departs through a connection as an entity.
